query:
insert or ignore into TracesCoveredBySkippedTests (
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line
            )
            select distinct
                agg_collect_nr,
                product_id,
                file_collect_nr,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                traced_line
            from TraceMappedLinesCoveredBySkippedTests
            where agg_collect_nr = $1
